marie (Support): Customer #4621 reports a spike in streaming 5xxs starting ~09:12 UTC, says their client sees 'broken pipe' mid-response and they were billed for the request.
kevin (eng-runtime): which endpoint / model? any request IDs?
marie (Support): /v1/generate (streaming) against run-latest. Customer pasted one request id: r-0a1b2c3d. They included logs showing chunked encoding then ECONNRESET.
lucy (Support): I asked for full tcpdump but customer can't share pcap. Sent a short snippet and the curl they used.
marie (Support): curl they used: ```curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Transfer-Encoding: chunked" --data-binary @- https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate``` then they pipe input and abort after ~1.2s.
sam (eng-infra): aborting client mid-stream should be classified as client_abort, not 5xx. Are we seeing gateway treating FIN/RST as backend failure?
kevin (eng-runtime): looking at r-0a1b2c3d in logs: upstream returned partial chunks, then proxy saw ECONNRESET and marked as 502. I'm pulling connection teardown traces.
deploy-bot: rollout/2026-03-01-optimizations finished to prod (no related changes to streaming path).
kevin (eng-runtime): repro plan: run a local curl that aborts midstream against staging gateway with identical proxy and capture headers: need exact chunk sizes and pacing.
lucy (Support): I can reproduce locally with their pattern: send 3 chunks then close. I get 502 in ~40% of attempts.
sam (eng-infra): likely race between proxy half-close detection and our chunk-flusher. Add debug flags to proxy to log halfclose reason.
marie (Support): customer is asking for billing credit if it's on our side. They said they were charged for tokens after abort.
kevin (eng-runtime): we should not bill for tokens after client closed. But current accounting marks request as 5xx and final token counts were recorded. I'll open a ticket to exclude client_abort-labelled flows from billing.
lucy (Support): escalation to billing + eng-sre. Asking customer for minimal repro (they already sent small script). Requested consent to run pcap with support.
sam (eng-infra): quick mitigation: treat ECONNRESET after upstream STREAM_END as client_disconnect and short-circuit 499 classification. Patch ready, rolling to canary in staging.
kevin (eng-runtime): also need to fix chunked parser: when chunked trailers are missing and peer sends FIN, we treated as protocol error. Should accept EOF after last 0 chunk if body ended. Filing PR.
marie (Support): noted. Promised customer a follow-up within 24h and offered temporary credit if we confirm misbilling.
lucy (Support): I'll keep thread updated with repro attempts and r-0a1b2c3d trace.
kevin (eng-runtime): attaching extracted trace snippet here (sanitized): ```[proxy] req=r-0a1b2c3d recv_chunks=3 sent_to_backend=partial state=halfclose reason=peer_fin```
marie (Support): thanks — will escalate billing after eng confirms postmortem. :thumbsup:
internal_note: do not include a title field; short thread, follow-up needed
